stem: An artist is making a scale model of a statue. On the model 2 inches represents 1 foot on the actual statue. Which graph best represents this relationship?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph showing a line with slope = 1 passing (0,0) to (20,20) with axes labeled Model Size (inches) and Statue Size (feet)

options.label: B
options.text: Graph showing a line with small positive slope passing (0,0) to (20,4) with axes labeled Model Size (inches) and Statue Size (feet)

options.label: C
options.text: Graph showing a line with slope less than 1 passing (0,0) to about (20,12) with axes labeled Model Size (inches) and Statue Size (feet)

options.label: D
options.text: Graph showing a line with steep slope passing (0,0) to about (4,20) with axes labeled Model Size (inches) and Statue Size (feet)

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled A, B, C, and D each titled 'Statue Scale', with y-axis labeled 'Statue Size (feet)', x-axis labeled 'Model Size (inches)' and lines as described above.
